cases.assertion: transaction metadata, schemas, events and durable end become visible atomically
before-commit is absent and after-commit ambiguity reconciles to one complete transaction
exact positional replay is idempotent and changed payload blocks
invalid hashes, ordinals, LSNs and limits publish no partial state
immutable schema fingerprint conflict rolls back the complete source transaction
a feedback-eligible durable boundary exists only after successful SQLite commit return
bounded reads copy only complete transaction ranges before releasing the SQLite reader
capture bursts reserve bounded failure, checkpoint and GC service with explicit overload
an exceeded pre-commit writer-hold bound rolls back without partial visibility
